Latest tier 1 figure is the FY2026 10-K: 83,334 as of 2026-01-31 (about 8.5 months old). No separate annual or integrated report, company website figure, or LinkedIn description headcount was found. The aggregator and Yahoo/Enway figures restate the 10-K. Revelio (87,829) and LinkedIn members (87,523) run about 5% above the 10-K, normal for a white-collar company. Notta wrongly labels 76,453 as January 2026 and was excluded. Trend: 72,682 (2024), 76,453 (2025), 83,334 (2026). Layoff rounds after January 2026 are unofficial and small relative to the total. Informatica acquisition not logged as an event because no close date or headcount effect was found. Engineering (~15,000), San Francisco (~10,000) and support (~5,000) figures are partial scope and excluded from sources.
